chat.heading: One prompt, every model.
chat.intro: Pick one model to iterate on an image, or several to see how each answers the same prompt. Any image can become the reference for your next prompt, or the first frame of a video.

welcome.lede: Each model draws in its own way. See the same prompt in each of them, check which runs best on your computer, and make your first picture.
